title: FluentDB - The AI Database Client for macOS
excerpt: A native Mac app for exploring, querying, and reshaping your data, with an AI co-pilot that writes SQL alongside you.
content_html:
The AI database client
for Mac.

Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server and more.
Fast, Secure, AI-first.

Free download for Mac

Apple Silicon native·Connects toPostgreSQLMySQLSQLiteSQL Serverand more

Features

AI-driven with strong guardrails

The only truly AI-first database client, wrapped in deep safety: guardrails that protect you from costly mistakes and keep your data from leaking.

Learn more

SQL editor, rethought for 2026

A full SQL editor with schema-aware autocomplete, formatting, and instant results. Switch to AI mode in a snap, and save your queries.

Learn more

A smooth explorer

Browse any table or view in a snap. Just hit ⌘P, search, and enter.

Learn more

Blazing fast even with 100K+ rows

Scroll thousands of rows in a fast, fluid data grid that never stutters.

Learn more

Visualize your data

Turn any query result into a chart without leaving the app.

Control it with MCP

Connect your own AI agent over MCP to manage connections for you.

Learn more

Bring your own model

Connect the model of your choice.

FluentDB has no model of its own. Point it at a provider you already trust with a key you control, or run one fully local. Your prompts go straight there, never through us.

Anthropic

Your Claude Code subscription or API key

OpenAI

Your Codex subscription or API key

Ollama

Local models, on your own Mac

Supported databases

We are actively building all the following drivers, stay tuned!
